output_list.reason: The 'mintTokens' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. This can be exploited to devalue the token.

The 'balances[_to] -= _amount;' statement can overflow if '_amount' is set to a very large value, causing it to wrap around and become very small, allowing the owner to transfer an arbitrary large number of tokens to any address, devaluing the token.
